If you're not using Cache Components, see the [Caching and Revalidating (Previous Model)](/docs/app/guides/caching-without-cache-components) guide. 17 18 Caching is a technique for storing the result of data fetching and other computations so that future requests for the same data can be served faster, without doing the work again. 19 20 ## Enabling Cache Components 21 22 You can enable Cache Components by adding the [`cacheComponents`](/docs/app/api-reference/config/next-config-js/cacheComponents) option to your Next config file: 23 24 ```ts filename="next.config.ts" highlight={4} switcher 25 import type { NextConfig } from 'next' 26 27 const nextConfig: NextConfig = { 28 cacheComponents: true, 29 } 30 31 export default nextConfig 32 ``` 33 34 ```js filename="next.config.js" highlight={3} switcher 35 /** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */ 36 const nextConfig = { 37 cacheComponents: true, 38 } 39 40 module.exports = nextConfig 41 ``` 42 43 > **Good to know:** When Cache Components is enabled, `GET` Route Handlers follow the same prerendering model as pages. See [Route Handlers with Cache Components](/docs/app/getting-started/route-handlers#with-cache-components) for details. 44 45 ## Usage 46 47 The [`use cache`](/docs/app/api-reference/directives/use-cache) directive caches the return value of async functions and components. It's useful when a component doesn't use [Request-time APIs](/docs/app/glossary#request-time-apis) like `cookies` or `headers`, but still needs to produce different output per request, such as `Math.random()` or `new Date()`. ```ts filename="app/page.tsx" switcher import { connection } from 'next/server' export default async function Page() { await connection() // prerendering stops here // the following code only runs at request time const rand = Math.random() return {rand} } ``` ```jsx filename="app/page.js" switcher import { connection } from 'next/server' export default async function Page() { await connection() // prerendering stops here // the following code only runs at request time const rand = Math.random() return {rand} } ``` ## Examples ### Synchronous database drivers Queries from synchronous database drivers like `better-sqlite3` complete during prerendering.
